examples.chinese: 我在家看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài jiā kànshū.
examples.english: I am reading at home.

examples.chinese: 他在學校，不在家。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào, bú zài jiā.
examples.english: He is at school, not at home.

examples.chinese: 他在學校，不在家。我在家看書。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài xuéxiào, bú zài jiā. Wǒ zài jiā kànshū.
examples.english: He is at school, not at home. I am at home reading.

examples.chinese: 現在十二點半。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn bàn.
examples.english: It is half past twelve.

examples.chinese: 我的錢包在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de qiánbāo zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: Where is my wallet?

examples.chinese: 我在學校，你要來這裡嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài xuéxiào, nǐ yào lái zhèlǐ ma?
examples.english: I am at the school. Do you want to come here? (Are you coming?)

examples.chinese: 我要在家看書、聽音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào zài jiā kànshū, tīng yīnyuè.
examples.english: I am going to read and listen to music at home.

examples.chinese: 弟弟在門後面。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zài mén hòumiàn.
examples.english: My younger brother is behind the door.

examples.chinese: 你的書在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de shū zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Your book is in the room.

examples.chinese: 弟弟在門的後面。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi zài mén de hòumiàn.
examples.english: The younger brother is behind the door.

examples.chinese: 爸爸在客廳喝咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài kètīng hē kāfēi.
examples.english: Dad is drinking coffee in the living room.

examples.chinese: 他在房間外面做什麼？
examples.pinyin: Tā zài fángjiān wàimiàn zuò shénme?
examples.english: What is he doing outside of the room?

examples.chinese: 你的筆在那本書上面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de bǐ zài nà běn shū shàngmiàn.
examples.english: Your pen is on top of the book.

examples.chinese: 哥哥喜歡在床上看書。
examples.pinyin: Gēge xǐhuān zài chuáng shàng kànshū.
examples.english: My elder brother likes to read in bed.

examples.chinese: 你的錢包在那件衣服下面。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de qiánbāo zài nà jiàn yīfu xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Your wallet is under that piece of clothing.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我的貓在房子外面曬太陽。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de māo zài fángzi wàimiàn shài tàiyáng.
examples.english: My cat is basking in the sun outside the house.

examples.chinese: 我家的廚房很大，我常常在家做飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de chúfáng hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng zài jiā zuòfàn.
examples.english: My kitchen is quite big, I often cook at home.

examples.chinese: 啊！在這裡！錢包在我的書下面。
examples.pinyin: A! Zài zhèlǐ! Qiánbāo zài wǒ de shū xiàmiàn.
examples.english: Ah! There it is! The wallet is under my book.

examples.chinese: 那不是我的，是哥哥的。我的錢包不在客廳裡。
examples.pinyin: Nà bú shì wǒ de, shì gēge de. Wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài kètīng lǐ.
examples.english: It is not mine. It is my elder brother’s. Mine is not in the living room.

examples.chinese: 我很忙，現在要去廚房做飯，你再去房間找吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn máng, xiànzài yào qù chúfáng zuòfàn, nǐ zài qù fángjiān zhǎo ba.
examples.english: I am very busy and I am going to the kitchen to cook now. You go check your room again.

examples.chinese: 媽，我跟友美要去喝下午茶，可是我的錢包不在房間裡。
examples.pinyin: Mā, wǒ gēn Yǒuměi yào qù hē xiàwǔ chá, kěshì wǒ de qiánbāo bú zài fángjiān lǐ.
examples.english: Mom, Youmei and I are going to have afternoon tea now, but my wallet is not in the bedroom.

examples.chinese: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
examples.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

examples.chinese: 現在我不渴，我很餓。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ bù kě, wǒ hěn è.
examples.english: I am not thirsty now, I am really hungry.

examples.chinese: A：現在幾點？ B：現在十點二十五分。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài jǐ diǎn? B: Xiànzài shí diǎn èrshíwǔ fēn.
examples.english: A: What time is it now? B: It’s 10:25.

examples.chinese: 現在幾點鐘？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài jǐ diǎnzhōng?
examples.english: What time is it now?

examples.chinese: 我們現在去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiànzài qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: Let’s go now, okay?

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 我很累，想在房間休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, xiǎng zài fángjiān xiūxí.
examples.english: I am tired; I want to take a rest in the room.

examples.chinese: 我常常在咖啡廳上網、看書。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài kāfēitīng shàngwǎng, kànshū.
examples.english: I often surf the internet and read at the café.

examples.chinese: 我現在不餓，只想吃一點兒水果。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài bú è, zhǐ xiǎng chī yìdiǎnr shuǐguǒ.
examples.english: I am not hungry now, I just want some fruit.

examples.chinese: 前天下午我在學校的圖書館看書。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān xiàwǔ wǒ zài xuéxiào de túshūguǎn kànshū.
examples.english: I read at the school library in the afternoon of the day before yesterday.

examples.chinese: 我的朋友在那家旅館前面等我。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de péngyǒu zài nà jiā lǚguǎn qiánmiàn děng wǒ.
examples.english: My friend is waiting for me in front of that hotel.

examples.chinese: 你要在這裡下車嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yào zài zhèlǐ xià chē ma?
examples.english: Do you want to get off the bus here?

examples.chinese: 現在這條街上沒有車。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zhè tiáo jiē shàng méiyǒu chē.
examples.english: There are no cars on this street now.

examples.chinese: 在這個大車站，坐公車、捷運、火車都很方便。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhège dà chēzhàn, zuò gōngchē, jiéyùn, huǒchē dōu hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: At this big station, taking the bus, MRT, or train is all very convenient.

examples.chinese: 你家在幾樓？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jiā zài jǐ lóu?
examples.english: Which floor is your home on?

examples.chinese: 那家咖啡廳在郵局對面。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā kāfēitīng zài yóujú duìmiàn.
examples.english: That coffee shop is across from the post office.

examples.chinese: 你看，他們在跳舞，跳得真好看！
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn, tāmen zài tiàowǔ, tiào de zhēn hǎokàn!
examples.english: Look, they are dancing; they dance really beautifully!

examples.chinese: 我明天要上書法課，現在要去買毛筆！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān yào shàng shūfǎ kè, xiànzài yào qù mǎi máobǐ!
examples.english: I have calligraphy class tomorrow; I need to go buy a writing brush now!

examples.chinese: 我媽媽的花店在百貨公司和超級市場中間。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma de huādiàn zài bǎihuò gōngsī hé chāojí shìchǎng zhōngjiān.
examples.english: My mother's flower shop is between the department store and the supermarket.

examples.chinese: 他不在教室裡上課，那他在哪裡？
examples.pinyin: Tā bù zài jiàoshì lǐ shàngkè, nà tā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.english: He is not in the classroom having class, so where is he?

examples.chinese: 我現在有課，不能去他家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiànzài yǒu kè, bù néng qù tā jiā.
examples.english: I have class now, so I cannot go to his house.

examples.chinese: 我感冒了，想在家休息。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gǎnmào le, xiǎng zài jiā xiūxi.
examples.english: I caught a cold, and I want to rest at home.

examples.chinese: 我昨天開始咳嗽，現在想去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān kāishǐ késòu, xiànzài xiǎng qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: I started to cough yesterday, and now I want to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: A:聽說你弟弟生病了，他現在怎麼樣？ B:他好了，明天可以去學校了。
examples.pinyin: A: Tīngshuō nǐ dìdi shēngbìng le, tā xiànzài zěnmeyàng? B: Tā hǎo le, míngtiān kěyǐ qù xuéxiào le.
examples.english: A: I heard your younger brother got sick; how is he now? B: He has gotten well; he can go to school tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我常常在電視上看到那位有名的醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ chángcháng zài diànshì shàng kàndào nà wèi yǒumíng de yīshēng.
examples.english: I often see that famous doctor on TV.

examples.chinese: 你們在聊什麼？聊得好開心。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zài liáo shénme? Liáo de hǎo kāixīn.
examples.english: What are you chatting about? You're chatting so happily.

examples.chinese: A:你現在要回宿舍嗎？ B:還沒，我要先去吃飯再回宿舍。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yào huí sùshè ma? B: Hái méi, wǒ yào xiān qù chīfàn zài huí sùshè.
examples.english: A: Are you going back to the dorm now? B: Not yet; I want to go eat first and then go back to the dorm.

examples.chinese: 他上個禮拜生病了，現在還在咳嗽。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng ge lǐbài shēngbìng le, xiànzài hái zài késou.
examples.english: He got sick last week, and he is still coughing now.

examples.chinese: 以前妹妹很不喜歡穿裙子，現在她覺得穿裙子很舒服。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián mèimei hěn bù xǐhuan chuān qúnzi, xiànzài tā juéde chuān qúnzi hěn shūfu.
examples.english: In the past, my younger sister really didn't like wearing skirts; now she feels that wearing skirts is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 我打電話給她，她沒接，可能在睡覺。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ diànhuà gěi tā, tā méi jiē, kěnéng zài shuìjiào.
examples.english: I called her, she didn't answer; she's probably sleeping.

examples.chinese: 我常在網路上聽我喜歡的音樂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cháng zài wǎnglù shàng tīng wǒ xǐhuān de yīnyuè.
examples.english: I often listen to music I like on the internet.

examples.chinese: A:這些相片是在哪裡照的？ B:花蓮。
examples.pinyin: A: Zhèxiē xiàngpiàn shì zài nǎlǐ zhào de? B: Huālián.
examples.english: A: Where were these photos taken? B: Hualien.

examples.chinese: A:你現在有空嗎？ B:我現在要跟太太出去，晚上再給你打電話。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ xiànzài yǒu kòng ma? B: Wǒ xiànzài yào gēn tàitai chūqù, wǎnshàng zài gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.english: A: Are you free now? B: I'm going out with my wife now; I'll call you again in the evening.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

examples.chinese: 在台灣，很多年輕人喜歡當咖啡店的老闆。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, hěn duō niánqīngrén xǐhuān dāng kāfēi diàn de lǎobǎn.
examples.english: In Taiwan, many young people like to be the boss of a coffee shop.

examples.chinese: 這件事情，他已經告訴大家了。我今天做了很多事，現在累了，需要休息了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shìqíng, tā yǐjīng gàosu dàjiā le. Wǒ jīntiān zuò le hěn duō shì, xiànzài lèi le, xūyào xiūxí le.
examples.english: This matter, he has already told everyone. Today I did many things; now I am tired and need to rest.

examples.chinese: 一個小時以前，他還在這裡。
examples.pinyin: Yí ge xiǎoshí yǐqián, tā hái zài zhèlǐ.
examples.english: An hour ago, he was still here.

examples.chinese: 他的父母都在學校當老師。
examples.pinyin: Tā de fùmǔ dōu zài xuéxiào dāng lǎoshī.
examples.english: His parents both work as teachers at a school.

examples.chinese: 現在我沒有時間，明天再跟你談這個問題。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ méiyǒu shíjiān, míngtiān zài gēn nǐ tán zhège wèntí.
examples.english: I don't have time now; I'll talk about this issue with you tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 結婚以前，他覺得工作最重要，現在他覺得家人最重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiéhūn yǐqián, tā juéde gōngzuò zuì zhòngyào, xiànzài tā juéde jiārén zuì zhòngyào.
examples.english: Before getting married, he felt work was most important; now he feels family is most important.

examples.chinese: 在這家咖啡廳，可以上網還可以看雜誌。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā kāfēitīng, kěyǐ shàngwǎng hái kěyǐ kàn zázhì.
examples.english: At this café, you can go online and also read magazines.

examples.chinese: 喂，請問王宜文小姐在嗎？
examples.pinyin: Wèi, qǐngwèn Wáng Yíwén xiǎojiě zài ma?
examples.english: Hello, may I ask, is Miss Wang Yiwen there?

examples.chinese: 我剛剛在學校附近看到中明。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gānggāng zài xuéxiào fùjìn kàndào Zhōngmíng.
examples.english: I just now saw Zhongming near the school.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 現在很晚了，你應該去睡覺了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài hěn wǎn le, nǐ yīnggāi qù shuìjiào le.
examples.english: It's very late now; you should go to sleep.

examples.chinese: 現在十點了，不早了，我想回家了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí diǎn le, bù zǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock now; it's not early anymore, I want to go home.

examples.chinese: 現在坐捷運的人很多，我們需要排隊。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zuò jiéyùn de rén hěn duō, wǒmen xūyào páiduì.
examples.english: There are many people taking the MRT now; we need to line up.

examples.chinese: 他們在裡面談話，你現在不要進去。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen zài lǐmiàn tánhuà, nǐ xiànzài búyào jìnqù.
examples.english: They are talking inside; don't go in now.

examples.chinese: 圖書館裡的人都在看書，很安靜。
examples.pinyin: Túshūguǎn lǐ de rén dōu zài kàn shū, hěn ānjìng.
examples.english: Everyone in the library is reading, so it is very quiet.

examples.chinese: 兒子跟女兒都在睡覺，你不要說得太大聲。
examples.pinyin: Érzi gēn nǚ'ér dōu zài shuìjiào, nǐ búyào shuō de tài dàshēng.
examples.english: Both my son and daughter are sleeping; don't speak too loudly.

examples.chinese: 我在台灣的生活不錯，很喜歡這裡，也有很多好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài Táiwān de shēnghuó búcuò, hěn xǐhuan zhèlǐ, yě yǒu hěn duō hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My life in Taiwan is good; I like it here a lot, and I also have many good friends.

examples.chinese: 你知道現在世界上有多少人嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào xiànzài shìjiè shàng yǒu duōshao rén ma?
examples.english: Do you know how many people there are in the world now?

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 我在客廳等了他一晚，真累！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài kètīng děng le tā yī wǎn, zhēn lèi!
examples.english: I waited for him in the living room all evening, really tired!

examples.chinese: 同學們，現在請打開課本，我們看第十五課。
examples.pinyin: Tóngxuémen, xiànzài qǐng dǎkāi kèběn, wǒmen kàn dì shíwǔ kè.
examples.english: Classmates, now please open your textbooks; we are looking at Lesson 15.

examples.chinese: A:對不起，我不小心拿了你的書？ B:原來書在你這裡，我剛才在教室裡找了好久。
examples.pinyin: A: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn ná le nǐ de shū? B: Yuánlái shū zài nǐ zhèlǐ, wǒ gāngcái zài jiàoshì lǐ zhǎo le hǎo jiǔ.
examples.english: A: Sorry, I accidentally took your book? B: It turns out the book is here with you; I was looking in the classroom for a long time just now.

examples.chinese: 華人用十二生肖代表每一年。他常常代表學校去參加游泳比賽，所以在學校非常有名。
examples.pinyin: Huárén yòng shí'èr shēngxiào dàibiǎo měi yì nián. Tā chángcháng dàibiǎo xuéxiào qù cānjiā yóuyǒng bǐsài, suǒyǐ zài xuéxiào fēicháng yǒumíng.
examples.english: Chinese people use the twelve zodiac signs to represent each year. He often represents the school to participate in swimming competitions, so he is very famous at school.

examples.chinese: 我是2005年七月在越南出生的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì èr líng líng wǔ nián qīyuè zài Yuènán chūshēng de.
examples.english: I was born in Vietnam in July 2005.

examples.chinese: 他手裡拿著禮物，在學校門口等著女朋友。
examples.pinyin: Tā shǒu lǐ názhe lǐwù, zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děngzhe nǚpéngyǒu.
examples.english: He is holding a gift in his hand and is waiting for his girlfriend at the school entrance.

examples.chinese: 他在跟家人談事情，已經講了三十分鐘的話了。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài gēn jiārén tán shìqíng, yǐjīng jiǎngle sānshí fēnzhōng de huà le.
examples.english: He is discussing something with his family; he has already been talking for thirty minutes.

examples.chinese: 從昨天晚上到現在，已經下了十個小時的雨了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zuótiān wǎnshang dào xiànzài, yǐjīng xià le shí ge xiǎoshí de yǔ le.
examples.english: From last night until now, it has already rained for ten hours.

examples.chinese: 捷運站的洗手間外面有很多人在排隊，你要去嗎？
examples.pinyin: Jiéyùn zhàn de xǐshǒujiān wàimiàn yǒu hěn duō rén zài páiduì, nǐ yào qù ma?
examples.english: Outside the restroom at the MRT station there are many people lining up; do you want to go?

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 我每天上學以前，一定先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngxué yǐqián, yídìng xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Every day before I go to school, I always eat breakfast at home first.

examples.chinese: 夏天的時候，食物不能在外面放太久。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de shíhou, shíwù bù néng zài wàimiàn fàng tài jiǔ.
examples.english: In summer, food cannot be left outside for too long.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 在追求夢想的路上，會遇到很困難的事情，只有不斷努力，才能完成夢想。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshang, huì yùdào hěn kùnnan de shìqing, zhǐyǒu bùduàn nǔlì, cái néng wánchéng mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, you will encounter very difficult things; only by making continuous efforts can you fulfill your dreams.

examples.chinese: 沒想到我奶奶那個年代流行的衣服，現在又流行起來了。李小龍（Bruce Lee）是七○年 （qīlíng niándài，1970∼1979） 非常有名的功夫明星。
examples.pinyin: Méi xiǎngdào wǒ nǎinai nàge niándài liúxíng de yīfu, xiànzài yòu liúxíng qǐlái le. Lǐ Xiǎolóng (Bruce Lee) shì qīlíng niándài fēicháng yǒumíng de gōngfu míngxīng.
examples.english: I never thought that the clothes that were popular in my grandmother's era would become popular again now. Bruce Lee was a very famous martial arts star in the 1970s.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better.

examples.chinese: 大偉挺喜歡他現在的工作，不但能挑戰自己，也能學習新的東西。
examples.pinyin: Dàwěi tǐng xǐhuān tā xiànzài de gōngzuò, bùdàn néng tiǎozhàn zìjǐ, yě néng xuéxí xīn de dōngxi.
examples.english: Dawei quite likes his current job; not only can it challenge him, but he can also learn new things.

examples.chinese: 現在大家都習慣用手機照相，一般的相機已經越來越少人使用了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài dàjiā dōu xíguàn yòng shǒujī zhàoxiàng, yìbān de xiàngjī yǐjīng yuèláiyuè shǎo rén shǐyòng le.
examples.english: Nowadays everyone is used to using their cell phones to take pictures; fewer and fewer people use regular cameras.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，不少大學教室裡的桌、椅是連在一起的，搬起來有點重。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, bùshǎo dàxué jiàoshì lǐ de zhuō, yǐ shì lián zài yìqǐ de, bān qǐlái yǒudiǎn zhòng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the desks and chairs in many university classrooms are joined together, so they are a bit heavy to move.

examples.chinese: 大人應該把刀子放在安全的地方，要不然小孩子碰了，可能會受傷。
examples.pinyin: Dàrén yīnggāi bǎ dāozi fàng zài ānquán de dìfāng, yàobùrán xiǎoháizi pèng le, kěnéng huì shòushāng.
examples.english: Adults should put knives in a safe place; otherwise, if children touch them, they might get hurt.

examples.chinese: 媽媽對哥哥說，以他現在剛上班的情況，不能急著買房子，得等錢存夠了再買。
examples.pinyin: Māma duì gēge shuō, yǐ tā xiànzài gāng shàngbān de qíngkuàng, bùnéng jízhe mǎi fángzi, děi děng qián cún gòu le zài mǎi.
examples.english: Mom said to older brother, "Given your current situation of just starting work, you can't rush to buy a house; you have to wait until you've saved enough money before buying."

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 李小姐的外語能力很強，也在歐洲工作過，我覺得這個翻譯工作很適合她。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě de wàiyǔ nénglì hěn qiáng, yě zài Ōuzhōu gōngzuò guò, wǒ juéde zhège fānyì gōngzuò hěn shìhé tā.
examples.english: Miss Li's foreign language ability is very strong, and she has also worked in Europe; I think this translation job is very suitable for her.

examples.chinese: 在我爺爺奶奶的年代，生活比較辛苦，不少窮人為了省錢，衣服破了還是繼續穿。
examples.pinyin: Zài wǒ yéye nǎinai de niándài, shēnghuó bǐjiào xīnkǔ, bùshǎo qióngrén wèile shěng qián, yīfu pò le háishì jìxù chuān.
examples.english: In my grandparents' era, life was relatively hard; many poor people, in order to save money, continued to wear clothes even after they were torn.

examples.chinese: 室友老是把髒襪子扔在地上，希望他能把這個壞習慣改掉。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu lǎo shì bǎ zāng wàzi rēng zài dìshang, xīwàng tā néng bǎ zhège huài xíguàn gǎi diào.
examples.english: My roommate always throws dirty socks on the floor; I hope he can change this bad habit.

examples.chinese: 小龍受不了在那個又熱又髒的工廠工作，只做了三天就離開了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎolóng shòubuliǎo zài nàge yòu rè yòu zāng de gōngchǎng gōngzuò, zhǐ zuò le sān tiān jiù líkāi le.
examples.english: Xiaolong could not bear to work in that hot and dirty factory; he only worked for three days and then left.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 小高總是在別人面前表現得很有禮貌，不過回到家就完全變了一個樣子。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎogāo zǒngshì zài biérén miànqián biǎoxiàn de hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò huí dào jiā jiù wánquán biàn le yí ge yàngzi.
examples.english: Xiao Gao always behaves very politely in front of others, but when he gets home he completely changes into a different person.

examples.chinese: 李老闆是個很實在的人，他賣的包子不但好吃，餡料（xiànliào， filling）也很實在，難怪生意好得不得了。今天天氣實在太熱了，雖然夏天的電費很貴，我還是把冷氣打開了。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ lǎobǎn shì ge hěn shízài de rén, tā mài de bāozi búdàn hǎochī, xiànliào yě hěn shízài, nánguài shēngyì hǎo de bùdéliǎo. Jīntiān tiānqì shízài tài rè le, suīrán xiàtiān de diànfèi hěn guì, wǒ háishì bǎ lěngqì dǎkāi le.
examples.english: Boss Li is a very honest person; the steamed buns he sells are not only delicious, but the filling is also very generous—no wonder his business is incredibly good. Today the weather is really too hot; although summer electricity bills are expensive, I still turned on the air conditioner.

examples.chinese: 爺爺在這棟公寓住了十年了，搬家時，用了好幾個大箱子來裝東西。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zài zhè dòng gōngyù zhù le shí nián le, bānjiā shí, yòng le hǎo jǐ ge dà xiāngzi lái zhuāng dōngxi.
examples.english: Grandpa has lived in this apartment building for ten years; when moving, he used several large boxes to pack things.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，孩子出生滿一個月的時候，有的父母會請客，慶祝孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, háizi chūshēng mǎn yí ge yuè de shíhou, yǒude fùmǔ huì qǐngkè, qìngzhù háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, when a child is one month old, some parents will treat guests to celebrate the baby's full month.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 我一直想到歐洲去旅行，只是現在忙得沒時間去，希望明年能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yìzhí xiǎng dào Ōuzhōu qù lǚxíng, zhǐshì xiànzài máng de méi shíjiān qù, xīwàng míngnián néng mèngxiǎng chéng zhēn.
examples.english: I have always wanted to travel to Europe, but I am so busy now that I have no time to go. I hope my dream can come true next year.

examples.chinese: 照華人的傳統習慣，女人生完孩子就要坐月子，一直在家休息到孩子滿月。
examples.pinyin: Zhào Huárén de chuántǒng xíguàn, nǚrén shēng wán háizi jiù yào zuòyuèzi, yīzhí zài jiā xiūxi dào háizi mǎnyuè.
examples.english: According to Chinese tradition, after a woman gives birth, she must practice confinement, resting at home until the baby is one month old.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都會跟親人聚在一起吃年夜飯、給紅包，互相恭喜新年好。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài chúxī nà tiān, dōu huì gēn qīnrén jù zài yīqǐ chī niányèfàn, gěi hóngbāo, hùxiāng gōngxǐ xīnnián hǎo.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people always gather with their kinsfolk to eat the New Year's Eve dinner, give red envelopes, and wish each other a Happy New Year.

examples.chinese: 從這裡走路回家有一點兒距離，而且現在還下著大雨，我們還是搭計程車算了。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhèlǐ zǒulù huí jiā yǒu yīdiǎnr jùlí, érqiě xiànzài hái xiàzhe dàyǔ, wǒmen háishì dā jìchéngchē suàn le.
examples.english: Walking home from here is a bit of a distance, and it's still raining heavily now, so we might as well take a taxi.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 今天是我女兒十歲的生日，我在蛋糕上點上十根蠟燭，一根代表一歲。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shì wǒ nǚ'ér shí suì de shēngrì, wǒ zài dàngāo shàng diǎn shàng shí gēn làzhú, yī gēn dàibiǎo yī suì.
examples.english: Today is my daughter's tenth birthday; I lit ten candles on the cake, each one representing one year of age.

examples.chinese: 在山上烤肉時要非常注意，一不小心就可能引起森林火災。
examples.pinyin: Zài shānshàng kǎoròu shí yào fēicháng zhùyì, yī bù xiǎoxīn jiù kěnéng yǐnqǐ sēnlín huǒzāi.
examples.english: When having a barbecue in the mountains, you must be very careful; if you are not careful, it may cause a forest fire.

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，人們喜歡在屋子外面吹著風、喝著茶，聊聊有趣的事。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, rénmen xǐhuān zài wūzi wàimiàn chuī zhe fēng, hē zhe chá, liáoliao yǒuqù de shì.
examples.english: On summer nights, people like to be outside the house, feeling the breeze, drinking tea, and chatting about interesting things.

examples.chinese: 前面發生了交通意外，為了避免被困在路上，我們還是走別條路吧。
examples.pinyin: Qiánmiàn fāshēng le jiāotōng yìwài, wèile bìmiǎn bèi kùn zài lùshàng, wǒmen háishì zǒu bié tiáo lù ba.
examples.english: There was a traffic accident ahead; to avoid being stuck on the road, we should take another route.

examples.chinese: 因為天氣太熱了，有一隻貓在車子底下休息，不肯離開。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tiānqì tài rè le, yǒu yì zhī māo zài chēzi dǐxià xiūxi, bù kěn líkāi.
examples.english: Because the weather is too hot, a cat is resting under the car and refuses to leave.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩在這場大地震中失去了親人，實在太可憐了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái zài zhè chǎng dà dìzhèn zhōng shīqù le qīnrén, shízài tài kělián le.
examples.english: That child lost his family in this big earthquake; it's really too pitiful.

examples.chinese: A: 現在的科技提供非常好用的網路服務，而且很多都是免費的。 B: 好用倒是好用，可是萬一沒有網路，就什麼都做不了了。
examples.pinyin: A: Xiànzài de kējì tígōng fēicháng hǎoyòng de wǎnglù fúwù, érqiě hěnduō dōu shì miǎnfèi de. B: Hǎoyòng dàoshì hǎoyòng, kěshì wànyī méiyǒu wǎnglù, jiù shénme dōu zuò bù liǎo le.
examples.english: A: Today's technology provides very easy-to-use internet services, and many are free. B: Sure, it's easy to use, but if there's no internet, then you can't do anything.

examples.chinese: 這次社區的中秋節活動，決定在戶外舉辦，萬一下雨了就搬到室內去。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shèqū de Zhōngqiūjié huódòng, juédìng zài hùwài jǔbàn, wànyī xià yǔ le jiù bān dào shìnèi qù.
examples.english: This community Mid-Autumn Festival event has been decided to be held outdoors; if it rains, it will be moved indoors.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 既然你不想衝浪，那就坐在海灘上曬曬太陽吧！
examples.pinyin: Jìrán nǐ bù xiǎng chōnglàng, nà jiù zuò zài hǎitān shàng shài shài tàiyáng ba!
examples.english: Since you don't want to surf, then just sit on the beach and soak up some sun!

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 現在突然下起了大雨，我們的計畫被破壞了，恐怕今天所有的活動都必須重新安排。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, wǒmen de jìhuà bèi pòhuài le, kǒngpà jīntiān suǒyǒu de huódòng dōu bìxū chóngxīn ānpái.
examples.english: Now it has suddenly started raining heavily, and our plans have been ruined; I'm afraid all of today's activities must be rearranged anew.

examples.chinese: 爺爺很喜歡在海邊釣魚，看著風景、吹著海風，他覺得舒服極了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye hěn xǐhuān zài hǎibiān diào yú, kàn zhe fēngjǐng, chuī zhe hǎifēng, tā juéde shūfu jí le.
examples.english: Grandpa really likes fishing by the sea; looking at the scenery and feeling the sea breeze, he feels extremely comfortable.

examples.chinese: 路旁有很多小白花，我常常摘一些放在書桌上，看著看著心情就愉快了。進辦公室前，別忘了摘下帽子，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Lù páng yǒu hěn duō xiǎo bái huā, wǒ chángcháng zhāi yīxiē fàng zài shūzhuō shàng, kàn zhe kàn zhe xīnqíng jiù yúkuài le. Jìn bàngōngshì qián, bié wàng le zhāi xià màozi, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: There are many small white flowers by the roadside; I often pick some and put them on my desk, and as I look at them, my mood becomes cheerful. Before entering the office, don't forget to take off your hat; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 地震後救災人員把握分分秒秒，努力把被困在房子底下的民眾救出來。
examples.pinyin: Dìzhèn hòu jiùzāi rényuán bǎwò fēnfēnmiǎomiǎo, nǔlì bǎ bèi kùn zài fángzi dǐxia de mínzhòng jiù chūlái.
examples.english: After the earthquake, the rescue workers seized every minute and every second, striving to rescue the people trapped under the houses.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 我在山上工作，手機的訊號很弱，朋友常抱怨我的電話不是打不通，就是聲音不清楚。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài shānshàng gōngzuò, shǒujī de xìnhào hěn ruò, péngyǒu cháng bàoyuàn wǒ de diànhuà bú shì dǎ bù tōng, jiù shì shēngyīn bù qīngchu.
examples.english: I work in the mountains, and the cell phone signal is very weak. My friends often complain that my phone either can't be reached or the voice is unclear.

examples.chinese: 那家民宿的地點實在太偏僻了，除了路不好走，附近也沒人住，想找個人問路都難。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā mínsù de dìdiǎn shízài tài piānpì le, chúle lù bù hǎo zǒu, fùjìn yě méi rén zhù, xiǎng zhǎo ge rén wèn lù dōu nán.
examples.english: That guesthouse's location is really too remote. Besides the road being hard to travel, there's no one living nearby either; it's hard even to find someone to ask for directions.

examples.chinese: 小在追求夢想的路上，別太在意別人說什麼，只要不斷地努力，就能夢想成真。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zài zhuīqiú mèngxiǎng de lùshàng, bié tài zàiyì biérén shuō shénme, zhǐyào búduàn de nǔlì, jiù néng mèngxiǎng chéngzhēn.
examples.english: On the road of pursuing your dreams, don't care too much about what others say; as long as you keep working hard, your dreams can come true.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: A:怎麼回事？外面怎麼這麼吵？ B:鄰居在修理屋頂，快修理好了，你忍耐一下吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Zěnme huí shì? Wàimiàn zěnme zhème chǎo? B: Línjū zài xiūlǐ wūdǐng, kuài xiūlǐ hǎo le, nǐ rěnnài yīxià ba.
examples.english: A: What's the matter? Why is it so noisy outside? B: The neighbor is repairing the roof; it will be fixed soon, so please put up with it for a bit.

examples.chinese: 在國外留學的時候，小史是我最好的兄弟，我們總是互相照顧、互相幫忙。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài liúxué de shíhou, Xiǎo Shǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de xiōngdì, wǒmen zǒngshì hùxiāng zhàogù, hùxiāng bāngmáng.
examples.english: When I was studying abroad, Xiao Shi was my best brother; we always took care of each other and helped each other.

examples.chinese: 就我對小林的了解，他是一個很實在的人，不但做事認真，說話也不誇張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù wǒ duì Xiǎo Lín de liǎojiě, tā shì yīgè hěn shízài de rén, bùdàn zuòshì rènzhēn, shuōhuà yě bù kuāzhāng.
examples.english: With regard to my understanding of Xiao Lin, he is a very honest person; not only does he work seriously, but he also doesn't exaggerate when he speaks.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 五年前經驗過護照被偷的意外後，每次出國我都把護照放在上衣裡面的口袋。
examples.pinyin: Wǔ nián qián jīngyàn guò hùzhào bèi tōu de yìwài hòu, měi cì chūguó wǒ dōu bǎ hùzhào fàng zài shàngyī lǐmiàn de kǒudài.
examples.english: After experiencing the accident of having my passport stolen five years ago, every time I go abroad, I put my passport in the pocket inside my jacket.

examples.chinese: 你在名牌服裝的專櫃工作，我想聽聽看你對穿著和品味的看法。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zài míngpái fúzhuāng de zhuānguì gōngzuò, wǒ xiǎng tīng tīng kàn nǐ duì chuānzhuó hé pǐnwèi de kànfǎ.
examples.english: You work at a designer clothing counter; I'd like to hear your opinion on dressing and taste.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 住在學校宿舍有一些限制，比如說晚上十點前必須回到宿舍。
examples.pinyin: Zhù zài xuéxiào sùshè yǒu yīxiē xiànzhì, bǐrú shuō wǎnshang shí diǎn qián bìxū huídào sùshè.
examples.english: Living in the school dormitory has some restrictions, for example, you must return to the dormitory before ten o'clock at night.

examples.chinese: 小何穿著綠色牛仔褲、紅襯衫，再戴上藍色的帽子，我覺得這些顏色配在一起很醜。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hé chuānzhe lǜsè niúzǎikù, hóng chènshān, zài dài shàng lánsè de màozi, wǒ juéde zhèxiē yánsè pèi zài yīqǐ hěn chǒu.
examples.english: Xiǎo Hé is wearing green jeans, a red shirt, and then puts on a blue hat; I think these colors paired together are very ugly.

examples.chinese: 小戴第一次跟女朋友的父母見面時，緊張得不得了，說話、吃飯都很不自在。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài dì yī cì gēn nǚpéngyǒu de fùmǔ jiànmiàn shí, jǐnzhāng de bùdéliǎo, shuōhuà, chīfàn dōu hěn bù zìzài.
examples.english: When Xiǎo Dài met his girlfriend's parents for the first time, he was extremely nervous, and he was very uncomfortable both talking and eating.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 電視上正在播出跨年演唱會，節目非常吸引人，你快來看吧。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shàng zhèngzài bōchū kuànián yǎnchànghuì, jiémù fēicháng xīyǐn rén, nǐ kuài lái kàn ba.
examples.english: The TV is broadcasting the New Year's Eve concert right now; the program is very attractive, so come watch it quickly.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 小戴才三十歲就已經是名牌服裝公司的大老闆，這麼年輕就有這樣的成就，實在不簡單。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Dài cái sānshí suì jiù yǐjīng shì míngpái fúzhuāng gōngsī de dà lǎobǎn, zhème niánqīng jiù yǒu zhèyàng de chéngjiù, shízài bù jiǎndān.
examples.english: Little Dai is only thirty years old and is already the big boss of a famous brand clothing company; to have such accomplishments at such a young age is really not simple.

examples.chinese: 在華語中心，每個學期老師都會帶領學生參加戶外教學的活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huáyǔ zhōngxīn, měi ge xuéqī lǎoshī dōu huì dàilǐng xuéshēng cānjiā hùwài jiàoxué de huódòng.
examples.english: At the Chinese language center, every semester the teacher leads students to participate in outdoor teaching activities.

examples.chinese: 有一些家長對現在的升學制度不滿，認為學校不應該逼孩子寫那麼多測驗題目。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē jiāzhǎng duì xiànzài de shēngxué zhìdù bùmǎn, rènwéi xuéxiào bù yīnggāi bī háizi xiě nàme duō cèyàn tímù.
examples.english: Some parents are dissatisfied with the current school advancement system and think that schools should not force children to write so many test questions.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese: 何小姐走路回家時發覺有人跟在她後面，嚇得她趕快跑進便利商店，不敢回家了。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě zǒulù huí jiā shí fājué yǒu rén gēn zài tā hòumiàn, xià de tā gǎnkuài pǎo jìn biànlì shāngdiàn, bù gǎn huí jiā le.
examples.english: When Miss He was walking home, she came to know that someone was following behind her, which scared her so much that she quickly ran into a convenience store and didn't dare go home.

examples.chinese: 李先生經常咳嗽，可是他完全不在意。直到今天咳得說不出話來了，才肯去看醫生。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng jīngcháng késòu, kěshì tā wánquán bù zàiyì. Zhídào jīntiān ké de shuō bù chū huà lái le, cái kěn qù kàn yīshēng.
examples.english: Mr. Li often coughs, but he doesn't care at all. It was not until today, when he coughed so much that he couldn't speak, that he was willing to go see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 小藍從小在育幼院長大，最大的願望就是將來能有一個溫暖的家庭。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lán cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiānglái néng yǒu yī gè wēnnuǎn de jiātíng.
examples.english: Xiao Lan grew up in an orphanage; her greatest wish is to have a warm family in the future.

examples.chinese: 在學習中文的期間，小林下課後除了複習功課，也和同學參加了不少社團活動。
examples.pinyin: Zài xuéxí Zhōngwén de qījiān, Xiǎo Lín xiàkè hòu chúle fùxí gōngkè, yě hé tóngxué cānjiā le bùshǎo shètuán huódòng.
examples.english: During the period of studying Chinese, after class Xiao Lin not only reviewed his lessons but also participated in quite a few club activities with classmates.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 假如死了真的能上天堂，我想任何人都希望能夠在那裡跟最愛的人在一起。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú sǐle zhēnde néng shàng tiāntáng, wǒ xiǎng rènhé rén dōu xīwàng nénggòu zài nàlǐ gēn zuì ài de rén zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: If after death one could truly go to heaven, I think anyone would hope to be able to be there together with the person they love most.

examples.chinese: 有人信上帝，有人不信。但在東西方的文化中，「上帝」的角色都是很重要的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén xìn Shàngdì, yǒu rén bú xìn. Dàn zài dōng xīfāng de wénhuà zhōng, “Shàngdì” de juésè dōu shì hěn zhòngyào de.
examples.english: Some people believe in God, and some do not. But in both Eastern and Western cultures, the role of “God” is very important.

examples.chinese: 金先生最近遇到了很不幸的事，他的父母在一場交通意外中去世了。
examples.pinyin: Jīn xiānsheng zuìjìn yùdàole hěn búxìng de shì, tā de fùmǔ zài yì chǎng jiāotōng yìwài zhōng qùshì le.
examples.english: Mr. Jin recently encountered a very unfortunate event: his parents died in a traffic accident.

examples.chinese: 在那場車禍中，那個孩子失去了父母，家裡只剩下他一個人，大家都很同情他。
examples.pinyin: Zài nà chǎng chēhuò zhōng, nàge háizi shīqù le fùmǔ, jiālǐ zhǐ shèng xià tā yī ge rén, dàjiā dōu hěn tóngqíng tā.
examples.english: In that car accident, that child lost his parents, and he was the only one left in the family; everyone sympathized with him.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 這家電腦公司本來只服務亞洲地區的民眾，現在服務範圍已經擴大到歐洲了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diànnǎo gōngsī běnlái zhǐ fúwù Yàzhōu dìqū de mínzhòng, xiànzài fúwù fànwéi yǐjīng kuòdà dào Ōuzhōu le.
examples.english: This computer company originally only served people in the Asian region, but now its service range has already expanded to Europe.

examples.chinese: 你知道第一次世界運動會是在哪裡舉行的嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhīdào dì yī cì shìjiè yùndònghuì shì zài nǎlǐ jǔxíng de ma?
examples.english: Do you know where the first World Games were held?

examples.chinese: A:要不是你幫忙，現在我還找不到工作呢！ B:沒什麼，朋友之間本來就應該互相幫助。
examples.pinyin: A: Yàobùshì nǐ bāngmáng, xiànzài wǒ hái zhǎo bù dào gōngzuò ne! B: Méi shénme, péngyǒu zhījiān běnlái jiù yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
examples.english: A: If it weren't for your help, I still wouldn't have found a job now! B: It's nothing; between friends, we should help each other by nature.

examples.chinese: 我是金東賢的戲迷，今天終於看到他本人，實在太開心了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Jīn Dōngxián de xìmí, jīntiān zhōngyú kàndào tā běnrén, shízài tài kāixīn le.
examples.english: I am a fan of Kim Dong-hyun; today I finally saw him in person, and I am really so happy.

examples.chinese: 某年某月的某一天，你會找到心中最理想的結婚對象，現在別急。
examples.pinyin: Mǒu nián mǒu yuè de mǒu yī tiān, nǐ huì zhǎodào xīnzhōng zuì lǐxiǎng de jiéhūn duìxiàng, xiànzài bié jí.
examples.english: On a certain day of a certain month in a certain year, you will find the most ideal marriage partner in your heart; don't rush now.

examples.chinese: 麗麗的老公在她生日那天，送了她九十九朵玫瑰花，好浪漫啊！
examples.pinyin: Lìlì de lǎogōng zài tā shēngrì nà tiān, sòng le tā jiǔshíjiǔ duǒ méiguīhuā, hǎo làngmàn a!
examples.english: Lili's husband gave her ninety-nine roses on her birthday; how romantic!

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 明天的主管會議在三樓的會議室舉行，經理要求大家不要遲到。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de zhǔguǎn huìyì zài sān lóu de huìyìshì jǔxíng, jīnglǐ yāoqiú dàjiā búyào chídào.
examples.english: Tomorrow's supervisor meeting will be held in the meeting room on the third floor; the manager requires everyone not to be late.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 不知道明哲今天怎麼了？老師叫了他好幾次，他就像木頭一樣，沒有反應。九二一大地震發生得太突然，不少民眾因為來不及反應，而被困在屋裡。
examples.pinyin: Bù zhīdào Míngzhé jīntiān zěnme le? Lǎoshī jiào le tā hǎojǐ cì, tā jiù xiàng mùtou yíyàng, méiyǒu fǎnyìng. / Jiǔ'èr yī dà dìzhèn fāshēng de tài tūrán, bùshǎo mínzhòng yīnwèi láibují fǎnyìng, ér bèi kùn zài wū lǐ.
examples.english: I don't know what's wrong with Mingzhe today? The teacher called him several times, but he was like a piece of wood, without any reaction. / The 921 earthquake happened too suddenly; many people were trapped inside their houses because they didn't have time to react.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 媽媽把放在院子裡的一堆空瓶子、空罐子都扔了。今天的作業是寫一篇作文，可是我的腦子空空的，一個字也寫不出來。
examples.pinyin: Māma bǎ fàng zài yuànzi lǐ de yī duī kōng píngzi, kōng guànzi dōu rēng le. Jīntiān de zuòyè shì xiě yī piān zuòwén, kěshì wǒ de nǎozi kōngkōng de, yī gè zì yě xiě bù chūlái.
examples.english: Mom threw away all the empty bottles and empty cans that were placed in the yard. Today's homework is to write a composition, but my mind is completely empty; I can't write a single word.

examples.chinese: 陸教授在自己的網站上發表有關教學和研究的成果，相當值得參考。
examples.pinyin: Lù jiàoshòu zài zìjǐ de wǎngzhàn shàng fābiǎo yǒuguān jiàoxué hé yánjiū de chéngguǒ, xiāngdāng zhídé cānkǎo.
examples.english: Professor Lu publishes the results of teaching and research on his own website, which are quite worth referring to.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 古先生很重視環保，購物時會準備環保袋，在餐廳吃飯也會用環保筷。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiānsheng hěn zhòngshì huánbǎo, gòuwù shí huì zhǔnbèi huánbǎo dài, zài cāntīng chīfàn yě huì yòng huánbǎo kuài.
examples.english: Mr. Gu attaches great importance to environmental protection; when shopping he prepares eco-friendly bags, and when eating in restaurants he also uses eco-friendly chopsticks.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 畢業當天，許多學生帶著攝影機在校園裡攝影，留下了珍貴的回憶。
examples.pinyin: Bìyè dāngtiān, xǔduō xuéshēng dài zhe shèyǐngjī zài xiàoyuán lǐ shèyǐng, liú xià le zhēnguì de huíyì.
examples.english: On graduation day, many students brought cameras and took pictures on campus, leaving behind precious memories.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 在國外工作的那幾年，他學會了什麼問題都自己解決，不依靠別人。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài gōngzuò de nà jǐ nián, tā xuéhuì le shénme wèntí dōu zìjǐ jiějué, bù yīkào biérén.
examples.english: In those few years working abroad, he learned to solve every problem himself, not relying on others.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: A:公司從明天起就不再提供免費的三餐了。 B:這麼重大的決定，為什麼現在才通知我們？
examples.pinyin: A: Gōngsī cóng míngtiān qǐ jiù bù zài tígōng miǎnfèi de sān cān le. B: Zhème zhòngdà de juédìng, wèishénme xiànzài cái tōngzhī wǒmen?
examples.english: A: Starting tomorrow, the company will no longer provide free three meals. B: Such a major decision—why are we only being notified now?

examples.chinese: 溫小姐在白色情人節那天，送給情人一盒巧克力。
examples.pinyin: Wēn xiǎojiě zài Báisè Qíngrén Jié nà tiān, sòng gěi qíngrén yì hé qiǎokèlì.
examples.english: On White Day, Miss Wen gave her lover a box of chocolates.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 華人在除夕那天，都要回到父母身邊，全家聚在一起吃年夜飯。
examples.pinyin: Huárén zài Chúxī nà tiān, dōu yào huídào fùmǔ shēnbiān, quánjiā jù zài yìqǐ chī niányèfàn.
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, Chinese people all return to their parents' side, and the whole family gathers together to eat the New Year's Eve dinner.

examples.chinese: 媽媽實在太會做飯了，只用了一個小時就變出一桌既豐富又好吃的大餐。
examples.pinyin: Māma shízài tài huì zuòfàn le, zhǐ yòng le yí ge xiǎoshí jiù biàn chū yì zhuō jì fēngfù yòu hǎochī de dàcān.
examples.english: Mom is really too good at cooking; in just one hour, she conjured up a table full of both abundant and delicious feast.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 每年農曆一月初一是華人新年的第一天。我父母每個月初寄錢給我，但我總是在月中就把錢花光了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Měi nián nónglì yī yuè chū yī shì Huárén xīnnián de dì yī tiān. 2. Wǒ fùmǔ měi ge yuè chū jì qián gěi wǒ, dàn wǒ zǒngshì zài yuè zhōng jiù bǎ qián huā guāng le.
examples.english: 1. The first day of the first lunar month each year is the first day of the Chinese New Year. 2. My parents send me money at the beginning of every month, but I always spend it all by the middle of the month.

examples.chinese: 幸虧你來幫忙，要不然我一個人絕對忙不過來。幸虧我把資料都存在雲端，要不然找不到隨身碟，怎麼開會呢？
examples.pinyin: 1. Xìngkuī nǐ lái bāngmáng, yàobùrán wǒ yí ge rén juéduì máng bú guòlái. 2. Xìngkuī wǒ bǎ zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, yàobùrán zhǎo bú dào suíshēndié, zěnme kāihuì ne?
examples.english: 1. Thanks to your help, otherwise I definitely wouldn't be able to handle it alone. 2. Fortunately, I saved all the data in the cloud; otherwise, if I couldn't find the USB drive, how could we have the meeting?

examples.chinese: 中秋節是華人團圓的日子，除了吃月餅、欣賞月亮，還會一起烤肉。小文從小在育幼院長大，到了二十歲才找到叔叔，跟家人團圓了。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngqiūjié shì Huárén tuányuán de rìzi, chúle chī yuèbǐng, xīnshǎng yuèliang, hái huì yìqǐ kǎoròu. Xiǎowén cóngxiǎo zài yùyòuyuàn zhǎngdà, dào le èrshí suì cái zhǎodào shūshu, gēn jiārén tuányuán le.
examples.english: The Mid-Autumn Festival is a day for Chinese people to have family reunion. Besides eating mooncakes and admiring the moon, they also have a barbecue together. Xiaowen grew up in an orphanage from a young age, and only at the age of twenty did he find his uncle and have a reunion with his family.

examples.chinese: 我們在山上拿著攝影機，等著太陽升起，把美麗的日出時刻錄下來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài shān shàng ná zhe shèyǐngjī, děng zhe tàiyáng shēng qǐ, bǎ měilì de rìchū shíkè lù xiàlái.
examples.english: We were on the mountain holding a video camera, waiting for the sun to rise, and recording the beautiful moment of sunrise.

examples.chinese: 在真實世界中沒有「龍」這種動物，那只是古人的想像。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhēnshí shìjiè zhōng méiyǒu “lóng” zhè zhǒng dòngwù, nà zhǐshì gǔrén de xiǎngxiàng.
examples.english: In the real world, there is no such animal as a "dragon"; that is only the imagination of ancient people.

examples.chinese: 天上有無數個星星，聚在一起就變成了美麗的銀河。
examples.pinyin: Tiānshàng yǒu wúshù ge xīngxing, jù zài yìqǐ jiù biànchéng le měilì de yínhé.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the sky; gathering together, they become the beautiful Milky Way.

examples.chinese: 康先生把這塊木頭刻成了一隻鳥，這個藝術作品完成後，還能放在美術館呢！
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiānsheng bǎ zhè kuài mùtou kè chéng le yī zhī niǎo, zhège yìshù zuòpǐn wánchéng hòu, hái néng fàng zài měishùguǎn ne!
examples.english: Mr. Kang carved this piece of wood into a bird; after this artwork is finished, it can even be placed in an art museum!

examples.chinese: 夏天的夜晚，在院子裡吹著涼快的風，欣賞天空美麗的星星， 簡直就像在天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān de yèwǎn, zài yuànzi lǐ chuīzhe liángkuai de fēng, xīnshǎng tiānkōng měilì de xīngxing, jiǎnzhí jiù xiàng zài tiāntáng yīyàng.
examples.english: On a summer night, feeling the cool breeze in the yard and enjoying the beautiful stars in the sky, it's virtually like being in heaven.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 在華人社會中，「龍」具有重要的文化意義，但「龍」其實是不存在的。
examples.pinyin: Zài Huárén shèhuì zhōng, "lóng" jùyǒu zhòngyào de wénhuà yìyì, dàn "lóng" qíshí shì bù cúnzài de.
examples.english: In Chinese society, the "dragon" has important cultural significance, but the "dragon" actually does not exist.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯在鄉下有一塊土地，可是地點很偏僻，想賣也賣不掉。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo zài xiāngxià yǒu yī kuài tǔdì, kěshì dìdiǎn hěn piānpì, xiǎng mài yě mài bù diào.
examples.english: My uncle has a piece of land in the countryside, but the location is very remote; even if he wants to sell it, he can't sell it.

examples.chinese: 人類的智慧表現在思考、溝通、欣賞、創造等方面。
examples.pinyin: Rénlèi de zhìhuì biǎoxiàn zài sīkǎo, gōutōng, xīnshǎng, chuàngzào děng fāngmiàn.
examples.english: Human wisdom is manifested in aspects such as thinking, communication, appreciation, and creation.

examples.chinese: 看電影時，如果要暫時離開座位，記得把重要物品帶在身上。
examples.pinyin: Kàn diànyǐng shí, rúguǒ yào zhànshí líkāi zuòwèi, jìde bǎ zhòngyào wùpǐn dài zài shēnshang.
examples.english: When watching a movie, if you need to temporarily leave your seat, remember to carry your important belongings with you.

examples.chinese: 今天上午學校附近發生了車禍，經過警察處理後，現在交通已恢復正常。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān shàngwǔ xuéxiào fùjìn fāshēng le chēhuò, jīngguò jǐngchá chǔlǐ hòu, xiànzài jiāotōng yǐ huīfù zhèngcháng.
examples.english: This morning a car accident occurred near the school. After the police handled it, traffic has now returned to normal.

examples.chinese: 他為了演好健身教練的角色，透過運動與調整飲食，讓身體維持在最佳的狀態。
examples.pinyin: Tā wèile yǎn hǎo jiànshēn jiàoliàn de juésè, tòuguò yùndòng yǔ tiáozhěng yǐnshí, ràng shēntǐ wéichí zài zuìjiā de zhuàngtài.
examples.english: In order to play the role of a fitness coach well, he keeps his body in the best condition through exercise and diet adjustment.

examples.chinese: 小年的夢想就是蓋一棟土地面積六十坪、三層樓高的房子，讓全家人都住在一起。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎonián de mèngxiǎng jiùshì gài yí dòng tǔdì miànjī liùshí píng, sān céng lóu gāo de fángzi, ràng quánjiā rén dōu zhù zài yìqǐ.
examples.english: Xiao Nian's dream is to build a three-story house with a land area of sixty ping, so that the whole family can live together.

examples.chinese: 上帝是不是存在，這是屬於宗教領域的問題，科學家的解釋不一定是正確的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngdì shì bú shì cúnzài, zhè shì shǔyú zōngjiào lǐngyù de wèntí, kēxuéjiā de jiěshì bù yídìng shì zhèngquè de.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not is a question that belongs to the religious field; scientists' explanations are not necessarily correct.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 每個人的一生都應該好好規劃，日子才不會白白地過去。導遊忘了跟小湯約好在紅毛城門口見面，害他白（白）等了一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Měi gè rén de yīshēng dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guīhuà, rìzi cái bù huì báibái de guòqù. Dǎoyóu wàng le gēn Xiǎo Tāng yuēhǎo zài Hóngmáochéng ménkǒu jiànmiàn, hài tā bái (bái) děng le yī gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Everyone should plan their life well so that days won't pass for nothing. The tour guide forgot to agree to meet Xiao Tang at the entrance of Fort San Domingo, causing him to wait in vain for an hour.

examples.chinese: 夏天時，在臺灣、日本、菲律賓都有颱風，這是很普遍的現象。
examples.pinyin: Xiàtiān shí, zài Táiwān, Rìběn, Fēilǜbīn dōu yǒu táifēng, zhè shì hěn pǔbiàn de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: In summer, there are typhoons in Taiwan, Japan, and the Philippines; this is a very common phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 到底上帝存在不存在，科學與宗教的觀點不同，說法也不一樣。
examples.pinyin: Dàodǐ Shàngdì cúnzài bù cúnzài, kēxué yǔ zōngjiào de guāndiǎn bùtóng, shuōfǎ yě bù yīyàng.
examples.english: Whether God exists or not, the viewpoints of science and religion are different, and their explanations are also different.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 我們下午四點要到天美飯店，她在那裡等我們。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ sì diǎn yào dào Tiānměi Fàndiàn, tā zài nàli děng wǒmen.
examples.english: We have to arrive at Tianmei Hotel at 4 in the afternoon. She will wait for us there.

examples.chinese: 友美，妳看，天美飯店在大學路。我現在知道怎麼走了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, nǐ kàn, Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài Dàxué Lù. Wǒ xiànzài zhīdào zěnme zǒu le.
examples.english: Look, Youmei. Tianmei Hotel is on Daxue Road. Now I know how to get there.

examples.chinese: （看地圖）啊！天美飯店在這裡！我知道這個地方，附近有郵局跟超級市場。
examples.pinyin: (Kàn dìtú) A! Tiānměi Fàndiàn zài zhèlǐ! Wǒ zhīdào zhè ge dìfang, fùjìn yǒu yóujú gēn chāojíshìchǎng.
examples.english: (Looking at the map) Ah! So here is Tianmei Hotel! I know this place. There is a post office and a supermarket nearby.

examples.chinese: 鞋子都在一樓，我們到樓下去吧！九點了，百貨公司快要關了。
examples.pinyin: Xiézi dōu zài yì lóu, wǒmen dào lóuxià qù ba! Jiǔ diǎn le, bǎihuògōngsī kuàiyào guān le.
examples.english: All the shoes are on the first floor. Let’s go downstairs. It’s 9:00; the department store is closing soon.

examples.chinese: 電梯在那裡！我們現在去買。
examples.pinyin: Diàntī zài nàlǐ! Wǒmen xiànzài qù mǎi.
examples.english: There is the elevator! Let’s go get them now.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 那麼我們現在去找他。
examples.pinyin: Nàme wǒmen xiànzài qù zhǎo tā.
examples.english: Let’s go ask him now.

examples.chinese: 現在他在上書法課，我們四點去吧。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài tā zài shàng shūfǎ kè, wǒmen sì diǎn qù ba.
examples.english: He is in the calligraphy class now. Let’s do it at 4 p.m.

examples.chinese: 太好了！在那裡看書很舒服。我們每天都能用那間教室嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zài nàlǐ kànshū hěn shūfu. Wǒmen měi tiān dōu néng yòng nà jiān jiàoshì ma?
examples.english: That’s awesome! Studying there is very comfortable. Can we use it every day?

examples.chinese: 現在我非常忙，沒有很多時間讀書，可是因為有語言交換，所以我的中文進步了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài wǒ fēicháng máng, méi yǒu hěn duō shíjiān dúshū, kěshì yīnwèi yǒu yǔyán jiāohuàn, suǒyǐ wǒ de Zhōngwén jìnbù le.
examples.english: Nowadays, I am very busy; I don’t have much time for studying. However, because of language exchange, I have improved (my Chinese) a lot.

items.wordHook: A left hand puts a seedling onto the 土(earth) → right there is where you are: 在(at).

examples.chinese: 我的房東都是每個月五號來收房租的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángdōng dōu shì měi ge yuè wǔ hào lái shōu fángzū de.
examples.english: My landlord always comes to collect the rent on the fifth of every month.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣極重視考試的成績，可是她覺得參加社團也會有很多收穫。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn jí zhòngshì kǎoshì de chéngjì, kěshì tā juéde cānjiā shètuán yě huì yǒu hěn duō shōuhuò.
examples.english: Chen Kexin highly values exam grades, but she feels that joining clubs will also bring many rewards.

examples.chinese: 我收到了健身中心的通知，下個月就要去當健身教練了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shōudào le jiànshēn zhōngxīn de tōngzhī, xià gè yuè jiù yào qù dāng jiànshēn jiàoliàn le.
examples.english: I received a notification from the fitness center; next month I will go be a fitness coach.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 便利商店的服務有賣票、收電話費和水電費等。
examples.pinyin: Biànlì shāngdiàn de fúwù yǒu mài piào, shōu diànhuàfèi hé shuǐdiànfèi děng.
examples.english: The services at the convenience store include selling tickets, collecting telephone bills, and water and electricity bills, etc.

examples.chinese: 張太太上個月生了一個女兒，我寫了一張卡片祝福她，希望孩子快快樂樂地長大。 我的孩子滿月時，收到很多朋友送的禮物和滿滿的祝福。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai shàng ge yuè shēng le yí ge nǚ'ér, wǒ xiě le yì zhāng kǎpiàn zhùfú tā, xīwàng háizi kuàikuàilèlè de zhǎngdà. Wǒ de háizi mǎnyuè shí, shōudào hěn duō péngyou sòng de lǐwù hé mǎnmǎn de zhùfú.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang gave birth to a daughter last month. I wrote a card to bless her, hoping the child will grow up happily. When my child was one month old, we received many gifts from friends and full blessings.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文程度，我除了認真上課、寫作業，還每天聽收音機的英文廣播。
examples.pinyin: Wèile tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù, wǒ chúle rènzhēn shàngkè, xiě zuòyè, hái měi tiān tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō.
examples.english: In order to raise my English level, besides attending class seriously and doing homework, I also listen to English radio broadcasts every day.

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 老闆收到一封寫滿越南文的信，辦公室沒人看得懂，非找人翻譯不可。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn shōudào yī fēng xiě mǎn Yuènánwén de xìn, bàngōngshì méi rén kàn de dǒng, fēi zhǎo rén fānyì bùkě.
examples.english: The boss received a letter written entirely in Vietnamese; no one in the office could understand it, so he absolutely must find someone to translate it.

examples.chinese: 有的人一喝牛奶就拉肚子，可能是因為身體吸收不料牛奶的營養。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu de rén yì hē niúnǎi jiù lādùzi, kěnéng shì yīnwèi shēntǐ xīshōu bù liǎo niúnǎi de yíngyǎng.
examples.english: Some people get diarrhea as soon as they drink milk; it may be because their body cannot absorb the nutrition in milk.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 員工：謝謝您幫了我一個大忙，這個小禮物請您收下。 主管：你太客氣了！這點兒小事真的沒什麼。
examples.pinyin: Yuángōng: Xièxie nín bāng le wǒ yī gè dà máng, zhège xiǎo lǐwù qǐng nín shōuxià. Zhǔguǎn: Nǐ tài kèqì le! Zhè diǎnr xiǎoshì zhēn de méishénme.
examples.english: Employee: Thank you for doing me a big favor; please accept this small gift. Supervisor: You're too polite! This little thing really is nothing serious.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方很偏僻，手機常收不到訊息，朋友很難跟我聯絡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng hěn piānpì, shǒujī cháng shōu bù dào xùnxí, péngyǒu hěn nán gēn wǒ liánluò.
examples.english: The place I live is very remote; my phone often can't receive information, and it's hard for friends to contact me.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 為了提高英文的聽力水平，我除了聽收音機的英文廣播，也會看美國的電視新聞。
examples.pinyin: Wèi le tígāo Yīngwén de tīnglì shuǐpíng, wǒ chú le tīng shōuyīnjī de Yīngwén guǎngbō, yě huì kàn Měiguó de diànshì xīnwén.
examples.english: In order to improve my English listening level, besides listening to English radio broadcasts, I also watch American TV news.

examples.chinese: 外面風大雨大，媽媽只好把還沒乾的衣服收進來，掛在屋內。
examples.pinyin: Wàimiàn fēng dà yǔ dà, māma zhǐhǎo bǎ hái méi gān de yīfu shōu jìnlái, guà zài wū nèi.
examples.english: Outside the wind and rain were strong, so Mom had no choice but to bring in the clothes that were not yet dry and hang them inside the house.

examples.chinese: 收到別人的信時，應該回信告訴對方收到了，這是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào biérén de xìn shí, yīnggāi huíxìn gàosu duìfāng shōudào le, zhè shì yī zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: When you receive a letter from someone, you should write back to tell the other person that you have received it; this is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，收到禮物的人要找機會回禮，表達自己的感謝。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, shōudào lǐwù de rén yào zhǎo jīhuì huílǐ, biǎodá zìjǐ de gǎnxiè.
examples.english: In Taiwan, people who receive gifts should find an opportunity to give a gift in return to express their gratitude.

examples.chinese: 前天我收到大學的來信，才知道我被錄取了，真開心。
examples.pinyin: Qiántiān wǒ shōudào dàxué de láixìn, cái zhīdào wǒ bèi lùqǔ le, zhēn kāixīn.
examples.english: The day before yesterday I received an incoming letter from the university, and only then did I learn that I had been admitted; I'm really happy.

examples.chinese: 在這家網路書店購買商品，顧客得先匯款。一般購物網站都是等收到顧客的匯款後，才寄出商品的。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā wǎnglù shūdiàn gòumǎi shāngpǐn, gùkè děi xiān huìkuǎn. Yībān gòuwù wǎngzhàn dōu shì děng shōudào gùkè de huìkuǎn hòu, cái jìchū shāngpǐn de.
examples.english: To purchase products at this online bookstore, customers must first remit money. Generally, shopping websites all wait until they have received the customer's remittance before they send out the products.

examples.chinese: 收到帳單的時候得準時去繳費，以免超過時間後得繳更多錢。
examples.pinyin: Shōudào zhàngdān de shíhou děi zhǔnshí qù jiǎofèi, yǐmiǎn chāoguò shíjiān hòu děi jiǎo gèng duō qián.
examples.english: When you receive the bill, you must go pay it on time, so as to avoid having to pay more money after the deadline.

examples.chinese: 要是新買的商品有問題，七天以內可帶收據到店裡處理。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi xīn mǎi de shāngpǐn yǒu wèntí, qī tiān yǐnèi kě dài shōujù dào diànlǐ chǔlǐ.
examples.english: If there's a problem with a newly purchased product, within seven days you can bring the receipt to the store to handle it.

examples.chinese: 公司交給你的支票記得要收好，別弄丟了。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jiāo gěi nǐ de zhīpiào jìde yào shōu hǎo, bié nòngdiū le.
examples.english: Remember to put away the check the company gave you properly; don't lose it.

examples.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
examples.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

examples.chinese: 拿到購物收據，要是發現算錯帳了，就請店員再算一次。
examples.pinyin: Ná dào gòuwù shōujù, yàoshi fāxiàn suàn cuò zhàng le, jiù qǐng diànyuán zài suàn yí cì.
examples.english: When you get the shopping receipt, if you find that the bill has been calculated wrong, ask the clerk to calculate it again.

examples.chinese: 過年時，著名點心店都會收到大量的訂單，甚至有顧客在半年前就下訂單了。
examples.pinyin: Guònián shí, zhùmíng diǎnxīn diàn dōu huì shōudào dàliàng de dìngdān, shènzhì yǒu gùkè zài bàn nián qián jiù xià dìngdān le.
examples.english: During Chinese New Year, famous pastry shops receive a large number of orders; some customers even place orders half a year in advance.

examples.chinese: 這個山區種了許多茶樹，到了收穫季節，就會有一群採茶姑娘上山採茶。
examples.pinyin: Zhège shānqū zhòng le xǔduō cháshù, dào le shōuhuò jìjié, jiù huì yǒu yī qún cǎi chá gūniang shàngshān cǎi chá.
examples.english: Many tea trees are planted in this mountainous area; when the harvest season comes, a group of tea-picking girls will go up the mountain to pick tea.

examples.chinese: 華人送禮最重心意，以這種方式向收禮的人表達關心與祝福。
examples.pinyin: Huárén sònglǐ zuì zhòng xīnyì, yǐ zhè zhǒng fāngshì xiàng shōu lǐ de rén biǎodá guānxīn yǔ zhùfú.
examples.english: Chinese people place the greatest value on thoughtfulness when giving gifts, using this way to express care and blessings to the recipient.

examples.chinese: 資源回收不分你我他，一個人的回收是榜樣，一群人的回收是力量。
examples.pinyin: Zīyuán huíshōu bù fēn nǐ wǒ tā, yī ge rén de huíshōu shì bǎngyàng, yī qún rén de huíshōu shì lìliàng.
examples.english: Resource recycling does not distinguish between you, me, and others; one person’s recycling is an example, and a group of people’s recycling is power.

examples.chinese: 食品罐頭吃完以後把罐子洗乾淨，就可以回收了。
examples.pinyin: Shípǐn guàntou chī wán yǐhòu bǎ guànzi xǐ gānjìng, jiù kěyǐ huíshōu le.
examples.english: After you finish eating canned food, wash the can clean, and then it can be recycled.

examples.chinese: 這家超商食品賣不完就丟掉的作法，不但白白浪費食物，回收處理的成本也增加了，長期下來十分浪費。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshāng shípǐn mài bù wán jiù diū diào de zuòfǎ, bùdàn báibái làngfèi shíwù, huíshōu chǔlǐ de chéngběn yě zēngjiā le, chángqī xiàlái shífēn làngfèi.
examples.english: This convenience store's practice of throwing away food that isn't sold out not only wastes food for nothing, but the cost of recycling processing also increases; over the long term, it is extremely wasteful.

examples.chinese: 家中的廢車可送到汽車修理工廠回收，多多少少能賣點錢。
examples.pinyin: Jiā zhōng de fèichē kě sòng dào qìchē xiūlǐ gōngchǎng huíshōu, duōduōshǎoshǎo néng mài diǎn qián.
examples.english: The derelict car at home can be sent to an auto repair shop for recycling; you can more or less sell it for some money.

examples.chinese: 學校邀請李教授來演講，內容相當精彩，讓我有很大的收穫。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào yāoqǐng Lǐ jiàoshòu lái yǎnjiǎng, nèiróng xiāngdāng jīngcǎi, ràng wǒ yǒu hěn dà de shōuhuò.
examples.english: The school invited Professor Li to give a lecture; the content was quite wonderful, which gave me a great harvest.

examples.chinese: 請你把空罐子放在袋子裡，好讓垃圾車一起回收。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ bǎ kōng guànzi fàng zài dàizi lǐ, hǎo ràng lājīchē yīqǐ huíshōu.
examples.english: Please put the empty cans in the bag, so that the garbage truck can recycle them together.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 我明天要把這份作業交給老師，遲了老師就不收了。
